newsitem.title: CANADA: Tembec to raise Spruce Falls stake.
newsitem.headline: Tembec to raise Spruce Falls stake.

text.p: Tembec Inc said on Thursday it agreed to purchase 1,032,081 class I special shares and 1,170,362 class III restricted voting special shares of Spruce Falls Acquisition Corp for C$7.00 per share.

After the purchase, Tembec will hold 60 percent class I special shares, 32 percent class III restricted voting special shares and 100 percent class IV special shares, Tembec said. The aggregate number of shares held by Tembec will represent about 51.3 percent of the outstanding class I special shares, class II restricted voting shares, class III restricted voting special shares and class IV special shares.

The purchase is pursuant to Tembec's right of first refusal under the shareholders agreement dated December 2, 1989 among 2863-1711 Quebec Inc, Spurce Falls Inc, Spruce Falls Acquisition Corp, Tembec and the class I and Class III shareholders of the company.
Tembec said it believes that the purchase of the shares represents a good investment.
